subunit: Trimers of one alpha 2(I) and two alpha 1(I) chains. Interacts with MRC2. Interacts with TRAM2. Interacts with MFAP4 in a Ca (2+)-dependent manner

complexes.name: Collagen type I homotrimer
complexes.function: A collagen fibrils type only found in foetal tissue, fibrosis and cancer tissue. Resistant to mammalian collagenases.
complexes.properties: Triple-helices consisting of about 1000 amino acids per chain forming a coiled coil structure. Each polypeptide forms a left-handed helix in which every third residue, glycine, comes into the center of the superhelix. Propeptides (telopeptides) at both ends of the molecular precursor undergo highly complex fibrillogenesis.

complexes.name: Collagen type I trimer
complexes.function: Forms the fibrils of tendon, ligaments and bones, also present in skin. In bones the fibrils are mineralized with calcium hydroxyapatite.
